senses.gloss: to smelt, melt; trnsf. to refine, purify, try.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:9:2">Y. Keth. VII, end, 31ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:11">Tosef. Keth. VII, 11</cite> <he>צוֹרֵף נחשת</he>, v. infra.

<cite ref="Yoma 72b:15">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 18:31">Ps. XVIII, 31</cite>) <he>זכה משמחתו … צוֹרַפְתּוֹ</he> if he deserves well, she (the Torah) cheers him; if not, she smelts him (through trials); <he>צורפתו לחיים</he> she steels him for life; <he>צורפתו למיתה</he> she smelts him for death.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 391:14">Yalk. Ex. 391</cite> <he>דרשתי</he> … <he>צָרַפְתִּי ובחנתי וכ׳</he> I studied and searched, refined and tested &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to tighten, harden. Yoma l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:3:7">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top <he>שצְרָפַתּוֹ</he> Var., v. <cite ref="R00669"><he>צָפַד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:10">Keth. VII, 10</cite> (among the occupations to which a wife may object) <he>מְצָרֵף נחושת</he>, expl.

<cite ref="Ketubot 77a:13">ib. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>חשלי דודי</he>, v. <cite ref="H01859"><he>חַשְׁלָא</he></cite>; anoth. opin. <he>מחתך נחושת וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01896"><he>חָתַךְ</he></cite>; Tosef.
ib. l. c. זה מתיך וכ׳ he that casts bronze.—Trnsf. to refine.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:7">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <he>צרופה</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 18:31">Ps. XVIII, 31</cite>) <he>לא נתנו המצות אלא לצָרֵף וכ׳</he> the (ceremonial) laws have been given for the purpose of refining (disciplining) men through them.
<cite ref="Psalms 18:31">Ib.</cite> <he>שצֵרְפוֹ הקב״ה וכ׳</he> (Abraham) whom the Lord tried in the furnace of fire.
Ib. (ref. to צֹרֵף, Is. XLI, 7) זה אברהם שצרפו וכ׳ that means Abraham, whom the Lord tried &c.; (Yalk. Is. 313 שנִצְרַף, Nif.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 5:7">Makhsh. V, 7</cite> <he>המוליך … לצָרְפָהּ</he> if one takes a ship out to sea for the sake of tightening it; <he>מוציא מסמר … לצָרְפוֹ</he> if one takes a (glowing) nail in the rain for the sake of hardening it; Tosef. ib. II, 16 <he>בשביל לצוֹרְפוֹ</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 13</cite> <he>צֵרְפָן אפי׳ וכ׳</he> (or <he>צְרָפָן</he>) if he hardened (baked) them (the earthen vessels) even in a peat fire.
<cite ref="Beitzah 32a:9">Bets. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>משיְצָרְפוֹ בכבשן</he> (Ms. M. <he>משישרפו</he>) from the time be baked it in the kiln.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a:14">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> (of iron weapons) <he>משיְצָרְפֵם בכבשן</he> when he has hardened them in the furnace, v. <cite ref="R00283"><he>צִחְצֵחַ</he></cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:5">Maasr. II, 5</cite> <he>ואם צֵרַף</he> (Y. ed. <he>צירף</he>) if he combined (ate them together). Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ top <he>שני … אין הבית מְצָרף</he> if two pieces (of leavened matter), each half the size of an olive, are in the same room, the room does not join them (so as to be counted one olive-size); if in one vessel, <he>הכלי מצרף</he> the vessel joins them.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 40a">Kidd. 40ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>מְצָרְפָהּ למעשה</he>, v. <cite ref="M00944"><he>מַחֲשָׁבָה</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to change small for large coin, opp. פָּרַט.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:2">Maas. Sh. IV, 2</cite> <he>כמות … שהוא מצרף</he> as the banker counts when he gives small change for large coins, not as he counts when giving large coins for small change; <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 3:3">Tosef. ib. III, 3</cite> <he>המְצָרֵיף … שמצריף</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>המצרף … מצטרף</he>) if one buys a gold Denar for coins designated for second tithes, he must count as the banker would when selling small change, not as he would, when buying large change.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 2:1">Shek. II, 1</cite> <he>מְצָרְפִין</he>, v. <cite ref="D01100"><he>דַּרְכּוֹן</he></cite>. Y. B. Mets. IV, end, 9ᵈ <he>לצוֹרְפָהּ … מְצָרְפָהּ ביפה</he> if he wants to change the defective coin to be spent in Jerusalem, he must exchange it as if it were of full value (v. Bab.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 52b">B. Mets. 52ᵇ</cite>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 48:3">Sifré Deut. 48</cite> <he>אחד מצרף דינר ואוכלו ואחד מצ׳ דינר ומניחו</he> one gathers a gold Denar and spends it, and another changes his accumulation for a gold Denar and puts it away; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 873">Yalk. ib. 873</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00147"><he>סָגַל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 313">Yalk. Is. 313</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:24">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 81</cite> <he>כבר נִצְרַפְנוּ</he> we have already been tried.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 4:4">Kel. IV, 4</cite> <he>משיִצָרְפוּ בכבשן</he> when they have been baked in the kiln; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 13</cite> <he>משיִצְטָרְפוּ</he>.

<cite ref="Nazir 35b">Naz. 35ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין היתר מִצְטָרֵף לאיסור</he> a permitted thing is not to be joined to a forbidden thing, i.e. if one ate simultaneously, one half of the legal size each, of a permitted and of a forbidden thing, the two must not be counted together to make up the legal size.
<cite ref="Nazir 4a:8">Ib. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>מִצְטָרְפִים זה עם זה</he> they are counted together.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 6:1">Ib. VI, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 47b:16">Ber. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>תשעה ועבד מִצְטָרְפִין</he> nine freemen and one slave may be combined (to make up the requisite number of ten for prayers).

<cite ref="Berakhot 47b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>שנים ושבת מצט׳</he> two persons (at meal) and the Sabbath may be combined (count for three persons); <he>שני ת״ח … מצט׳</he> two scholars (at meal) who are engaged in discussion are counted as three.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:4">Mikv. III, 4</cite> <he>מצט׳</he> are combined to make up the legally required quantity of water; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 3:3">Tosef. Maas. Sh. III, 3</cite>, v. supra.
